body: 创作一张历史题材的虚构纪实照片，描绘 1969 年夏天美国户外音乐节的观众，广角视角，中景有坐在草地上的年轻成年人，远处是舞台与帐篷。服装、发型、相机和交通工具符合时代，避免智能手机和现代标识。午后薄雾、褪色胶片色彩，人物自然，不复制任何现存历史照片。

en.title: 1969 outdoor music festival
en.description: Fictional period-style outdoor festival scene: seated adults, vintage camera and vehicles, distant stage, faded film texture
en.body:
## How to use

Use the exact recorded prompt. No reference image is required. Changes to the prompt or inputs create an untested variant.

## Observed result

Fictional period-style outdoor festival scene: seated adults, vintage camera and vehicles, distant stage, faded film texture. Not an archival photograph or a verified reconstruction.

## Source and generation

The source provides an original prompt; this production uses the separately recorded working prompt. [Source](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/image-prompting#use-historical-and-real-world-context). Source-post engagement does not measure this newly generated example.

Produced with the built-in GPT Image tool. The tool did not return an exact provider model ID; GPT Image 2.6 is the research topic, not a verified version claim for this output. All reference images used here were generated for this project.

## 使用方法

使用本次实际提交的提示词，无需参考图。修改提示词或底图后属于未验证的新变体。

## 观察结果

虚构音乐节场景包含草地观众、旧相机、复古车辆和远处舞台，采用褪色胶片质感。这不是历史档案照片，也不是经核实的现场复原。

## 来源与生成

来源公开原提示词；本次使用单独记录的制作提示词。[来源](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/image-prompting#use-historical-and-real-world-context)。来源帖互动数不代表本次新生成案例的热度。

本例使用内置 GPT Image 工具生成。工具未返回精确模型 ID；GPT Image 2.6 是调研主题，不作为本次输出的已验证版本声明。使用的参考图均为本项目新生成。
